title: Switch Account local confirmed

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Choosing Switch on This Mac must ask for confirmation before activating the selected saved snapshot.
After confirmation, CodexPill must activate the selected saved snapshot, persist account state, relaunch Codex, and run the post-switch active-account refresh path.
Choosing Use on This Mac from Add Account success must route through the existing local switch path without a second confirmation.

targetSurface: CodexPill local switch fake-client workflow boundary

nonClaims: Does not prove native confirmation panel rendering or click automation.
Does not prove live Codex process relaunch or live app-server refresh.
Does not prove remote host switching.
